The '''Orbital Advertisement Ring''' was a conglomeration of a vast number of revolving billboards that had gathered around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]. This massive ring of debris, primarily made up of old advertising materials, choked out natural [[Vulpter (star)|sunlight]].

==History==
Around the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] had overtaken the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]<ref name="CE" /> in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It turned the planet into a dumping ground for products that it could not sell elsewhere. The native [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereens]] were forced to drill vast tunnels to serve as storage facilities, and anything deemed too large or toxic to store on the planet was launched into orbit, forming a ring of debris around Vulpter.<ref name="CE" />

Called the Orbital Advertisement Ring, this object was a marvel of corporate thinking, inducing both awe and horror in those who encountered it. Massive, revolving billboards each several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length and width formed a ring around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]], cluttering the sky so effectively that [[Vulpter (star)|sunlight]] could no longer penetrate the swirling mass. Combined with a dense field of debris scattered among the [[Neon/Legends|neon]] monstrosities, the orbital advertisement ring cast immense shadows, wiping out entire crops as it passed overhead. From the ground, when a being on Vulpter looked up at the night sky, all that could be seen from one horizon to the other were blinking billboards hawking cut-rate products, silent tombstones for the impoverished populace below.<ref name="WC" />

Each year, in Vulpter's orbit, an [[Vulpter Orbital|annual race]] was held by the Vulptereen population to bring some diversion into their otherwise harsh lives. The contestants raced through the orbital advertisement field until one racer crossed the finish line or all other racers were eliminated.<ref name="WC" />

==Behind the scenes==
A brief description of the Orbital Advertisement Ring was included in an article on the planet Vulpter for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2005]]. The Orbital Advertisement Ring was considered a primary setting for the scenario «Racing in the Rings», during which the players, acting as members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], had to ensure the victory of the pilot [[Lon Wert]] in the orbital race. According to the rules of the Roleplaying Game, any attempt to travel through the orbital advertisement ring in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] adds +5 to the DC of Pilot checks for maneuvers or stunts while in the debris field.
